title: 6 (mostly) Patriots thoughts before training camp
text: In a solo episode, Andrew breaks down what a successful training camp would look like for Drake Maye, what we learned about the Patriots from a recent ESPN story, why two UDFAs could make the roster and when to visit training camp this summer.
